title: Kevin O'Connell on Kyler Murray: I want him to get healthy, you never know what could happen

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin O'Connell on Kyler Murray: I want him to get healthy, you never know what could happen
sources.description: The Vikings made Kyler Murray their quarterback choice to open the 2026 season, but it didn't take long for their plans to go awry.
